name: tnf-field-cell
description: One cell in a TNF field: a TNF bolus diffuses in the medium (FVReactionDiffusion), RegionMean reads it at the cell's surface, one-site occupancy (Kd 19 pM) drives Lipniacki 2004 NF-kB's TNF_R and Calzone 2010's TNF node, and NF-kB's nuclear fraction drives Calzone's NF-kB node.

kappa.description: NF-kB node switching rate (1/s): ln 2 / NF-kB's nuclear half-rise (decision 25)

k_time.description: death-machinery clock (Calzone units per s), > 0; 1/120 here, Study 1's fastest clock, so the fate network responds within 1000 s

r_tx.description: transcription-scale steps' ON rate (1/s), from Lipniacki

absorb_death.description: 1: Apoptosis and NonACD stay on once on (death is irreversible; decision 28); 0: Calzone's reversible death nodes. A switch: any nonzero value is absorbing

Kd.description: TNF-TNFR1 dissociation constant (uM): 1.9e-11 M at 37 C, Grell et al. 1998

nuclear_fraction.doc:
Evaluate a set of user-configured mathematical expressions as a single Step.

Configuration
-------------
expressions : list[dict]
    List of ``{"out": <str>, "expr": <str>}`` entries. Each ``out`` becomes
    an output port and state field.
params : dict[str, float], optional
    Named constants available to expressions without becoming input ports.
functions : str, optional
    SymPy ``lambdify`` backend module name (default ``"numpy"``).
debug : bool, optional
    If True, prints inferred ports, dependency order, and compilation details.

Notes
-----
Single-pass evaluation in dependency order; not a simultaneous-equation
solver. Cyclic dependencies require a different approach (fixed-point
iteration or root finding).

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
